about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Product Designer in Chicago
about.description: A product designer who gets excited about making complicated things simple. Currently at Meridian Health. Previously at Searchless AI.

leadIn.label: WHAT I DO
leadIn.thesis: I design products that make complicated work feel simple enough to show someone else.
leadIn.scope: Healthcare, SaaS, 0 to 1, and enterprise alignment. Progress, save states, and language people can repeat back.
leadIn.bridging: Less clicking. More of the actual job.
leadIn.integration: Beyond screens, I care about the journey: where people get lost, what they have to type twice, and whether they trust that their work is saved.

coreEngineering.label: Core Engineering
coreEngineering.title:
Proven stack.
Measurable results.
coreEngineering.p1: I develop applied AI systems using TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, and LangChain, structuring workflows and exposing models as services through Flask and FastAPI.
coreEngineering.p2: Integrated into full-stack apps with Next.js, Express.js, and Spring Boot, backed by PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM.
coreEngineering.p3: All projects use disciplined version control, Docker containerization, and are built for stable production deployment.
